name: Green Bazaar, upstairs
why: Everyone photographs the ground floor. Upstairs is where the dried fruit sellers are, and they will make you taste nine things before you buy one.

name: The mosaic bus stops on Abai
why: Soviet mosaics still sitting at ordinary bus stops. People wait for the 63 in front of them every day without looking up.

name: Canteen on Zhibek Zholy
why: No menu, no English, no sign. You point at what looks good. Lunch costs less than a coffee in the centre.

name: The courtyard behind Panfilov
why: Old apartment blocks with apple trees in the middle. Grandmothers on the benches will talk to you whether or not you share a language.

name: Butakovka, the lower trail
why: A bus and then three hours of walking. Not the famous one, which is exactly why there is nobody on it.

name: Book market at Baraholka
why: Second-hand Russian paperbacks stacked on car bonnets. I found my grandmother's school textbook there.

name: The dam steps at Medeu
why: 842 steps. Everybody counts them and everybody gets a different number. Go up at dusk when the skating rink lights come on.

name: Mural wall, 11th microdistrict
why: Two blocks of walls repainted every spring by students. It looks different every year, so no guidebook can keep up with it.
